result.title: A Few More Tokens Ahead: Reinforcing Parallelism in Diffusion LLMs
result.summary: Parallel generation is widely regarded as an inherent advantage of diffusion large language models. Yet our fixed-quota evaluation of four representative models reveals severe degradation across mathematics and code, with all scores below 15% at 16 tokens per step. Token-level probes identify local predictive potential near the observed prefix, especially in mathematical text. We propose RePara, which reinforces short consecutive token blocks through group-relative policy optimization and reduces rollout and log-probability recomputation costs. On LLaDA and SDAR, \ours improves GSM8K and MATH-500 accuracy over JustGRPO under reduced denoising budgets, with a 1.96x training-step speedup in our LLaDA/MATH setup.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对四个代表性扩散语言模型做固定配额解码评测，发现每步 16 token 时数学与代码得分均低于 15%，并用 token 级探针发现前缀附近存在局部预测潜力；据此提出 RePara，通过 group-relative 策略优化强化短连续 token 块的并行生成，同时降低 rollout 与 log-prob 重算成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本扩散 LLM 的并行块生成与训练监督线索可供核查：其对固定配额下并行退化、并行收益与去噪预算成本的诊断，可能对应 LVR 中并行状态生成与动态计算预算的评价问题；但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移需研究者自行验证。
